title: Kynolith canon entry
description: One canon or narrative entry stored in Data/ JSON. canon_tag is a string of at most 32 characters. The allowlist is exactly CANON, GAME CANON, and UNAPPROVED. The only tag that may omit approval_ref is the exact value UNAPPROVED. approval_ref resolution is checked by Tools/canon_validator.py.

canon_tag.description: At most 32 characters. Allowed values are exactly CANON, GAME CANON, and UNAPPROVED. GAME CANON includes a space. Empty fails canon_tag_empty. Any other value fails canon_tag_not_allowed.

source_pages.description: Non-empty array of integers. For non-placeholder text, Tools/canon_validator.py requires every page to be from 8 through 20 inclusive. Placeholder entries may omit this field.
